confidence_notes: Restaurant estimates use crowdsourced [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Merida) and [June 2026 Expatistan data](https://cuantocuestavivir.com/merida-mexico/); prices vary and are not all specific to July. Wine is estimated using a markup over local beer. Accommodation estimates are holistic and less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use other inland tourist cities in southern Mexico, including Oaxaca, as a general basis, adjusted for Mérida's visitor demand and July conditions.
